info.title: pika/pika-h3-flex-image-to-video
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "pika/pika-h3-flex-image-to-video", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Request body for `POST /proxy/pika/v1/media/pika/pika-h3-flex/image-to-video`. Send `image`, `last_frame_image` or both.

example.prompt: The camera slowly pushes in as the leaves begin to sway in the wind

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. `auto` picks one from the prompt and the media inputs. Omit it to let Pika choose: `auto` when `rewrite` is on, else the first media input's ratio, else 16:9.

channel_mode.description: Audio stems only. `mono` downmixes before separation; `stereo` keeps both channels. The video's audio does not change.

duration.description: Video length in whole seconds, 5 to 15.

image.description: URL of the first-frame image, a static JPEG, PNG or WebP of at most 24 MiB and 40 million pixels.

last_frame_image.description: URL of the last-frame image, with the same format and size limits as `image`.

output_mode.description: `video` returns the video only. `audio-stems` also returns Dialogue, Music and Effect WAV stems in `output.stems`, and adds Pika's per-second stem separation charge.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video and its audio.

resolution.description: Output resolution. 480p and 768p are native. 1080p, 2k and 4k generate at 768p and then upscale, keeping the audio and frame rate.

rewrite.description: Improve the prompt before generation. Set it to false to use the prompt as written.

seed.description: Seed for the video, 0 or more.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description: Comfy Router output schema for Pika's video models: the terminal `GET /proxy/pika/v1/media/jobs/{request_id}` job document. The produced video is at `output.video.url`. Pika's `billing` record is removed.

url.description: Download URL of the generated file.

id.description: Job id used to poll for status.

model_id.description: The Pika catalog entry the job ran.

status.description: Job status: queued, running, completed or failed.

usage.description: Units Pika reported for the job.

code.description: Machine-readable failure code, such as invalid_input, content_moderation or provider_error.

PikaMediaJobOutput.description: The finished job's media, set when `status` is `completed`.

media_type.description: Which field carries the file: video or audio.
